proposedRoute.route: First-frame image-to-video creation from one still
proposedRoute.inputRole: Exact opening frame, not generic appearance reference
proposedRoute.durationPolicy: One native short duration offered by the selected first-frame mode, no more than ten seconds. Eight or ten seconds only when actually supported. Record the selected and returned values.
proposedRoute.audioRequest: Silent; audio off only if an actual supported control is available. Record any returned audio separately. No song or lip-sync conditioning.
proposedRoute.liveModeRequirement: A supported exact first-frame creation mode that can retain the full 16:9 source. If only generic references or existing-video editing is offered, this proposed route is not ready for execution.
proposedRoute.executionOwner: CFA Nova/root after the source decision and actual provider controls are reconciled
proposedRoute.boundsMeaning: One native short clip per provider route, Gemini and Flow, under the unchanged original SW-2 brief; separate preflight for each; zero retries.
